Name: Gift Discovery
Author: aloofLlama
Description:
[color=#D4D4D8]Want to uncover everyone's unique gift tastes? Can't remember who you have gifted things to? Not sure what gifts to pack on gift-giving-days? [/color]
[spoiler][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Especially great for Qi gift questing![/color][/size][/spoiler]
[size=5][b]Gift Item Tooltip[/b][/size]
Hold an item (or hover in your inve[font=Arial]ntory) and easily see:[/font]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][font=Arial]Who loves/likes/neutral/dislikes/hates it[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][font=Arial]Who you haven't gifted it to yet[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][font=Arial]Who you are full friends with (black names)[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][font=Arial]Who you aren't full friends with (purple names)[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][font=Arial]Who you can't gift today (grey names)[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][font=Arial]Who is standing near you (underline & bold names)[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][font=Arial]Which mod the item is from[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[/list][size=5][b]NPC Tooltip [/b][/size]
Stand next to an NPC, or hover their name in the Social Page and easily see:
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Arial]Their heart levels[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Arial]If you can't gift them today (grey name)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Arial]Their loved/liked/neutral/disliked/hated gifts[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Arial]Which given gifts you have in your backpack (shown first and includes the name of the item)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Arial]Their current location (in Social Page only)[/font][/size][/*]
[/list](Disclaimer: I don't play with the 'all gift information' setting. I tried to add some features and config options for those that do so it isn't overwhelming but still usable. Open to suggestions if that needs adjusted.)

[size=5][b]Learn Yourself[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]You can choose to see information that:[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Only this farmer has learned*[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]You have learned on any of your farms*[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]All gift information in the game[/size][/color][/*]
[/list][size=3]*it starts learning as soon as you start playing with it[/size]

Toggle on/off with a button press, or hold a non-giftable item (e.g. a tool).

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
The NPC tooltip feature pairs really well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23374]Social Page Order Redux[/url]

Tested with the following mods. Very likely to work with others.
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22591]Adventurer's Guild Expanded for 1.6[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20884]Grains Overhull[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url] ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]2[/url]) ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]3[/url])[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26650]Culinary Delight[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3578]More New Fish[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30138]Nature in the Valley (Catchable Creatures)[/url] [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42968]NITV - SH's Wild Animals In The Valley[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26113]Simple Tea Expansion[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22376]Uncle Iroh Approved Tea[/url][/*]
[/list]Learned gift tastes are printed to the SMAPI log so you can double check accuracy if using with non-tested mods.
